raw_definitions: Definisi : at the ~, apabila loceng berbunyi; ring a ~, (colloq) saya rasa saya pernah dengar nama itu: Rahmat Ramly – yes, the name certainly rings a ~, Rahmat Ramly –ya, saya rasa saya pernah dengar nama itu; saved by the ~, (colloq) terselamat; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : vt furnish with bell(s) memasang loceng pd. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : n 1. (hollow cup-shaped device) loceng; (if large) loceng, genta; (if small, tinkling) genta, circir, giring-giring, loceng; 2. sound made by bell, bunyi loceng: she ran to the door on hearing the ~, dia berlari ke pintu apabila mendengar bunyi loceng; 3. electrical device that emits a ringing sound, loceng; 4. flared end of certain wind instruments, serombong; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
